from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_FLOOR, ROUND_HALF_UP

# ==============================================================================
# CONSTANTS SECTION
# ==============================================================================

# Sec 16(ia) - Standard deduction
STD_DEDUCTION_OLD = Decimal('50000')
STD_DEDUCTION_NEW = Decimal('75000')

# Sec 10(13A) - HRA percentages
HRA_METRO_PCT = Decimal('0.50')
HRA_NON_METRO_PCT = Decimal('0.40')
HRA_RENT_EXCESS_PCT = Decimal('0.10')

# Sec 24(b) and Sec 71(3A) - House property loss cap (old regime)
HP_LOSS_CAP = Decimal('200000')

# Sec 80C - Investments limit (old regime)
SEC_80C_LIMIT = Decimal('150000')

# Sec 80CCD(1B) - NPS contribution limit (old regime)
SEC_80CCD_1B_LIMIT = Decimal('50000')

# Sec 80D - Health insurance limits (old regime)
SEC_80D_SELF_NORMAL = Decimal('25000')
SEC_80D_SELF_SENIOR = Decimal('50000')
SEC_80D_PARENTS_NORMAL = Decimal('25000')
SEC_80D_PARENTS_SENIOR = Decimal('50000')

# First Schedule, Part III, Para A - Old regime tax slabs and rates
OLD_SLABS_U60 = [
    (Decimal('250000'), Decimal('250000'), Decimal('0')),
    (Decimal('500000'), Decimal('250000'), Decimal('0.05')),
    (Decimal('1000000'), Decimal('500000'), Decimal('0.20')),
    (None, Decimal('1000000'), Decimal('0.30')),
]

OLD_SLABS_SENIOR = [
    (Decimal('300000'), Decimal('300000'), Decimal('0')),
    (Decimal('500000'), Decimal('200000'), Decimal('0.05')),
    (Decimal('1000000'), Decimal('500000'), Decimal('0.20')),
    (None, Decimal('1000000'), Decimal('0.30')),
]

OLD_SLABS_SUPER_SENIOR = [
    (Decimal('500000'), Decimal('500000'), Decimal('0')),
    (Decimal('1000000'), Decimal('500000'), Decimal('0.20')),
    (None, Decimal('1000000'), Decimal('0.30')),
]

# Sec 115BAC - New tax regime tax slabs and rates
NEW_SLABS = [
    (Decimal('300000'), Decimal('300000'), Decimal('0')),
    (Decimal('700000'), Decimal('400000'), Decimal('0.05')),
    (Decimal('1000000'), Decimal('300000'), Decimal('0.10')),
    (Decimal('1200000'), Decimal('200000'), Decimal('0.15')),
    (Decimal('1500000'), Decimal('300000'), Decimal('0.20')),
    (None, Decimal('1500000'), Decimal('0.30')),
]

# Sec 87A - Rebate limits and thresholds
OLD_REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT = Decimal('500000')
OLD_REBATE_MAX = Decimal('12500')
NEW_REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT = Decimal('700000')
NEW_REBATE_MAX = Decimal('25000')

# First Schedule - Surcharge tiers and rates (Old & New)
# Thresholds
SURCHARGE_T1 = Decimal('5000000')
SURCHARGE_T2 = Decimal('10000000')
SURCHARGE_T3 = Decimal('20000000')
SURCHARGE_T4 = Decimal('50000000')

# Rates
SURCHARGE_RATE_T1 = Decimal('0.10')
SURCHARGE_RATE_T2 = Decimal('0.15')
SURCHARGE_RATE_T3 = Decimal('0.25')
SURCHARGE_RATE_T4 = Decimal('0.37')  # Old regime only, new capped at 25%

# Health and Education Cess rate
CESS_RATE = Decimal('0.04')

# ==============================================================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ==============================================================================

def round_nearest_ten(amount: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    """
    Sec 288A / 288B rounding:
    First drop paise (floor to whole rupees), then round to the nearest multiple of 10
    where a last digit of 5 or more rounds UP.
    """
    whole = amount.quantize(Decimal('1'), rounding=ROUND_FLOOR)
    # Divide by 10, round half up to nearest integer, multiply by 10
    return (whole / Decimal('10')).quantize(Decimal('1'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP) * Decimal('10')

def compute_slab_tax(taxable_income: Decimal, slabs: list) -> tuple[Decimal, list[tuple[str, Decimal]]]:
    total_tax = Decimal('0')
    breakdown = []
    for upper_limit, lower_limit, rate in slabs:
        if taxable_income <= lower_limit:
            continue
        if upper_limit is None or taxable_income <= upper_limit:
            taxable_in_slab = taxable_income - lower_limit
        else:
            taxable_in_slab = upper_limit - lower_limit
        
        tax_in_slab = (taxable_in_slab * rate).quantize(Decimal('1'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
        total_tax += tax_in_slab
        
        if upper_limit is None:
            desc = f"Tax on slab above {lower_limit:,} at {rate*100}%"
        else:
            desc = f"Tax on slab {lower_limit+1:,} to {upper_limit:,} at {rate*100}%"
        breakdown.append((desc, tax_in_slab))
    return total_tax, breakdown

def get_surcharge_rate(income: Decimal, is_new_regime: bool) -> Decimal:
    if income > SURCHARGE_T4:
        return Decimal('0.25') if is_new_regime else SURCHARGE_RATE_T4
    if income > SURCHARGE_T3:
        return SURCHARGE_RATE_T3
    if income > SURCHARGE_T2:
        return SURCHARGE_RATE_T2
    if income > SURCHARGE_T1:
        return SURCHARGE_RATE_T1
    return Decimal('0')

def calculate_base_tax_and_surcharge(income: Decimal, slabs: list, is_new_regime: bool) -> tuple[Decimal, Decimal]:
    tax, _ = compute_slab_tax(income, slabs)
    surch_rate = get_surcharge_rate(income, is_new_regime)
    surch = (tax * surch_rate).quantize(Decimal('1'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    return tax, surch

# ==============================================================================
# REGIME COMPUTATION
# ==============================================================================

def compute_regime(inp: dict, is_new_regime: bool) -> tuple[dict, int, int]:
    trace = []
    
    gross_salary = Decimal(str(inp['gross_salary']))
    age = int(inp['age'])
    
    trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Gross salary",
        "amount": str(gross_salary),
        "clause": "Sec 17(1)"
    })
    
    # Standard Deduction
    std_ded = STD_DEDUCTION_NEW if is_new_regime else STD_DEDUCTION_OLD
    actual_std_ded = min(std_ded, gross_salary)
    trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Standard deduction",
        "amount": str(-actual_std_ded),
        "clause": "Sec 16(ia)"
    })
    
    salary_after_std = gross_salary - actual_std_ded
    
    # HRA Exemption (Old regime only)
    hra_exemption = Decimal('0')
    if not is_new_regime:
        hra_received = Decimal(str(inp['hra_received']))
        basic_plus_da = Decimal(str(inp['basic_plus_da']))
        rent_paid = Decimal(str(inp['rent_paid']))
        is_metro = bool(inp['rent_city_is_metro'])
        
        if rent_paid > 0 and hra_received > 0:
            rent_excess = rent_paid - (basic_plus_da * HRA_RENT_EXCESS_PCT)
            rent_excess = max(Decimal('0'), rent_excess)
            metro_pct = HRA_METRO_PCT if is_metro else HRA_NON_METRO_PCT
            salary_pct_limit = basic_plus_da * metro_pct
            
            hra_exemption = min(hra_received, rent_excess, salary_pct_limit)
            hra_exemption = max(Decimal('0'), hra_exemption)
            
        if hra_exemption > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "HRA exemption",
                "amount": str(-hra_exemption),
                "clause": "Sec 10(13A)"
            })
            
    net_salary = salary_after_std - hra_exemption
    
    # House Property Loss (Old regime only)
    hp_loss_setoff = Decimal('0')
    if not is_new_regime:
        home_loan_interest = Decimal(str(inp['home_loan_interest']))
        if home_loan_interest > 0:
            hp_loss_setoff = min(home_loan_interest, HP_LOSS_CAP)
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Loss from self-occupied house property set off",
                "amount": str(-hp_loss_setoff),
                "clause": "Sec 24(b) and Sec 71(3A)"
            })
            
    gti = max(Decimal('0'), net_salary - hp_loss_setoff)
    
    # Chapter VI-A Deductions (Old regime only)
    ch_via_total = Decimal('0')
    if not is_new_regime:
        # Sec 80C
        sec_80c = min(Decimal(str(inp['sec_80c'])), SEC_80C_LIMIT)
        if sec_80c > 0:
            ch_via_total += sec_80c
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Section 80C",
                "amount": str(-sec_80c),
                "clause": "Sec 80C"
            })
            
        # Sec 80CCD(1B)
        sec_80ccd_1b = min(Decimal(str(inp['sec_80ccd_1b'])), SEC_80CCD_1B_LIMIT)
        if sec_80ccd_1b > 0:
            ch_via_total += sec_80ccd_1b
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Section 80CCD(1B)",
                "amount": str(-sec_80ccd_1b),
                "clause": "Sec 80CCD(1B)"
            })
            
        # Sec 80D
        sec_80d_total = Decimal('0')
        health_ins_self = Decimal(str(inp['health_ins_self']))
        health_ins_parents = Decimal(str(inp['health_ins_parents']))
        parents_senior = bool(inp['parents_senior'])
        
        self_limit = SEC_80D_SELF_SENIOR if age >= 60 else SEC_80D_SELF_NORMAL
        sec_80d_self_allowed = min(health_ins_self, self_limit)
        sec_80d_total += sec_80d_self_allowed
        
        parents_limit = SEC_80D_PARENTS_SENIOR if parents_senior else SEC_80D_PARENTS_NORMAL
        sec_80d_parents_allowed = min(health_ins_parents, parents_limit)
        sec_80d_total += sec_80d_parents_allowed
        
        if sec_80d_total > 0:
            ch_via_total += sec_80d_total
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Section 80D",
                "amount": str(-sec_80d_total),
                "clause": "Sec 80D"
            })
            
        # Sec 80A(2) cap
        if ch_via_total > gti:
            diff = ch_via_total - gti
            ch_via_total = gti
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Chapter VI-A deduction capping adjustment",
                "amount": str(diff),
                "clause": "Sec 80A(2)"
            })
            
    total_income_unrounded = max(Decimal('0'), gti - ch_via_total)
    total_income_rounded = round_nearest_ten(total_income_unrounded)
    
    income_rounding_diff = total_income_rounded - total_income_unrounded
    if income_rounding_diff != 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Rounding of total income",
            "amount": str(income_rounding_diff),
            "clause": "Sec 288A"
        })
        
    final_total_income = int(total_income_rounded)
    
    # Tax Computation
    if is_new_regime:
        slabs = NEW_SLABS
    else:
        if age >= 80:
            slabs = OLD_SLABS_SUPER_SENIOR
        elif age >= 60:
            slabs = OLD_SLABS_SENIOR
        else:
            slabs = OLD_SLABS_U60
            
    base_tax, slab_breakdown = compute_slab_tax(total_income_rounded, slabs)
    for desc, amt in slab_breakdown:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": desc,
            "amount": str(amt),
            "clause": "Sec 115BAC" if is_new_regime else "First Schedule, Part III, Para A"
        })
        
    # Rebate Sec 87A
    rebate = Decimal('0')
    if is_new_regime:
        if total_income_rounded <= NEW_REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT:
            rebate = min(base_tax, NEW_REBATE_MAX)
        else:
            # Marginal relief for new regime Sec 87A
            excess_income = total_income_rounded - NEW_REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT
            if base_tax > excess_income:
                rebate = base_tax - excess_income
    else:
        if total_income_rounded <= OLD_REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT:
            rebate = min(base_tax, OLD_REBATE_MAX)
            
    if rebate > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Rebate under Section 87A",
            "amount": str(-rebate),
            "clause": "Sec 87A"
        })
        
    tax_after_rebate = max(Decimal('0'), base_tax - rebate)
    
    # Surcharge & Surcharge Marginal Relief
    surch_rate = get_surcharge_rate(total_income_rounded, is_new_regime)
    surch = (tax_after_rebate * surch_rate).quantize(Decimal('1'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    
    if surch > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": f"Surcharge at {surch_rate*100}%",
            "amount": str(surch),
            "clause": "First Schedule"
        })
        
        # Check Surcharge Marginal Relief
        threshold = None
        if total_income_rounded > SURCHARGE_T4:
            threshold = SURCHARGE_T4
        elif total_income_rounded > SURCHARGE_T3:
            threshold = SURCHARGE_T3
        elif total_income_rounded > SURCHARGE_T2:
            threshold = SURCHARGE_T2
        elif total_income_rounded > SURCHARGE_T1:
            threshold = SURCHARGE_T1
            
        if threshold is not None:
            t_tax, t_surch = calculate_base_tax_and_surcharge(threshold, slabs, is_new_regime)
            max_allowed_tax_surch = t_tax + t_surch + (total_income_rounded - threshold)
            actual_tax_surch = tax_after_rebate + surch
            if actual_tax_surch > max_allowed_tax_surch:
                mr_amount = actual_tax_surch - max_allowed_tax_surch
                surch -= mr_amount
                trace.append({
                    "kind": "tax",
                    "description": "Marginal relief on surcharge",
                    "amount": str(-mr_amount),
                    "clause": "First Schedule"
                })
                
    tax_plus_surcharge = tax_after_rebate + surch
    
    # Health and Education Cess
    cess = (tax_plus_surcharge * CESS_RATE).quantize(Decimal('1'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    if cess > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Health and Education Cess at 4%",
            "amount": str(cess),
            "clause": "Health and Education Cess"
        })
        
    total_tax_unrounded = tax_plus_surcharge + cess
    total_tax_rounded = round_nearest_ten(total_tax_unrounded)
    
    tax_rounding_diff = total_tax_rounded - total_tax_unrounded
    if tax_rounding_diff != 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Rounding of tax payable",
            "amount": str(tax_rounding_diff),
            "clause": "Sec 288B"
        })
        
    final_tax_payable = int(total_tax_rounded)
    
    result_dict = {
        "total_income": final_total_income,
        "tax_payable": final_tax_payable,
        "trace": trace
    }
    return result_dict, final_total_income, final_tax_payable

# ==============================================================================
# MAIN ENTRY POINT
# ==============================================================================

def compute(inp: dict) -> dict:
    old_res, _, _ = compute_regime(inp, is_new_regime=False)
    new_res, _, _ = compute_regime(inp, is_new_regime=True)
    return {
        "old": old_res,
        "new": new_res
    }
